tracks.title: Tinderwick
tracks.where: Tinderwick · Tinderwick Lumenary · The Beacon — Floor I · The Beacon — Floor II · The Beacon — Lantern Room · Vesper Crossroads · Vesper Crossroads Inn · Lanternway · Tinderwick Spoke · Lanternway · Lowleaf Spoke · Lanternway · Galehigh Spoke · Lanternway · Nightreach Spoke · Hearthfall
tracks.mood: The hometown lullaby — lanterns in the dark, cosy and a little homesick. The source of the Vesper motif.

tracks.title: Apprentice's House
tracks.where: Apprentice's House · Tinderwick General Store
tracks.mood: Embers banked low — the hometown lullaby gone indoors at night, a 6/8 sway by the coals, homesick and safe.

tracks.title: Duskapple Orchard
tracks.where: Duskapple Orchard
tracks.mood: First light on the water — the hometown tune's rising half asked under orchard boughs, Lydian wonder with a thread of mystery.

tracks.title: Dimglass Coast
tracks.where: Dimglass Coast · Pearlmoor Quay · Wrackline Path · Lanternfall Road · Pearlmoor Breakwater · Pearlmoor Tide Lumenary · Pearlmoor Chandlery · Pearlmoor Quayside Inn · The Lifting House · Gullcry Rock
tracks.mood: The road that teaches you to wander — brisk, salt-aired, optimistic; the hometown tune breaking into a stride.

tracks.title: Tideglass Cavern
tracks.where: Tideglass Cavern · Tideglass Gallery · The Under-Lane
tracks.mood: Buoy-light drift — a becalmed, glittering sea-cave; the coast road's tune reduced to a glint over dripping water.

tracks.title: The Tide blessing
tracks.where: The Tide-blessing festival on Pearlmoor Quay (the cutscene after the Tide Gleam is relit)
tracks.mood: The going-out song — lantern boats on moonlit water; the quay waltz turned into a cool, glowing, sure ceremony.

tracks.title: Hillside Allotments
tracks.where: Hillside Allotments · Lightkeeper's Point
tracks.mood: Low tide, lantern strings — the quay waltz late and quiet, a lonely-but-cosy sway on the edge of town.

tracks.title: The Old Light — The Winding Room
tracks.where: The Old Light — The Winding Room
tracks.mood: Festival of the floating lights — the quay waltz in its happiest dress, quick, ornamented and playful.

tracks.title: Saltreach Fen
tracks.where: Saltreach Fen
tracks.mood: A slow drift through reed shallows — a breathy woodwind wanders and the lapping water answers; melancholy, never sad.

tracks.title: Saltreach Deeps
tracks.where: Saltreach Deeps
tracks.mood: The same fen lonelier and further in — a boat-rocking 6/8 through bone-white mist, one questioning phrase at a time.

tracks.title: Sunkbell Shallows
tracks.where: Sunkbell Shallows
tracks.mood: The fen relit — open water, a drowned shrine bell ringing under the ripples, a warmer lilting waltz you've earned.

tracks.title: Lowleaf Hollow
tracks.where: Lowleaf Hollow · Gloamwood Dell
tracks.mood: A dim-green glowmoss forest where every dewdrop catches cyan light — Lydian wonder, enchanted and curious.

tracks.title: The Wanderwood
tracks.where: The Wanderwood · The Far Side · Lowleaf Verdant Lumenary · Lowleaf Guest-bower · Georgina's Cottage
tracks.mood: The safe glow at the heart of the dark forest — a lantern-lit music-box lullaby in a gentle waltz; hearth over wonder.

tracks.title: The Sounding Cave
tracks.where: The Sounding Cave · Glowmoss Deep · Glowmoss Deep B1F · Spore Grotto · Grovefall
tracks.mood: The glowing-dark deep forest — a glassy bell melody whose echoes answer across the black, sparse and cathedral-like, with a drained grey shadow in it.

tracks.title: Cinderhead Mine
tracks.where: Cinderhead Mine
tracks.mood: Ink-black galleries where crystal veins and lamp-fire are the only light — a slow miners' hymn, melancholy but faintly warm.

tracks.title: Cinderhead Stone Lumenary
tracks.where: Cinderhead Stone Lumenary
tracks.mood: The mine under pressure — groaning timbers, charged air, a terse staccato motif over a driving low walk; held-breath tension before the wall.

tracks.title: Cinderhead Deep
tracks.where: Cinderhead Deep · Cinderhead Deep B1F · Cinderhead Deep B2F
tracks.mood: The deep galleries where dense crystal turns the dark luminous — a sparkle-led descent, minor warming to its relative major.

tracks.title: Galehigh Terraces
tracks.where: Galehigh Terraces · Galehigh Skyloft
tracks.mood: Updraft — giddy, wind-buffeted propulsion on the cliff-farms, kites snapping overhead in the last fire-light before the climb.

tracks.title: Galehigh Storm Lumenary
tracks.where: Galehigh Storm Lumenary · The Steady Gust Inn · Terrace Cottage · The Kite-Maker's
tracks.mood: Lanterns on the Wind — the windy cliff seen from inside the warm farmstead at dusk: cosy, a touch wistful, the wind a sigh at the shutters.

tracks.title: Windward Stair
tracks.where: Windward Stair · The Wind-Eye · Thunderroost · Stormfall
tracks.mood: The Long Climb — airy, building, breath-quickening; each phrase re-launches a step higher so the loop feels like ascent.

tracks.title: Pale Vault Glacier
tracks.where: Pale Vault Glacier
tracks.mood: Aurora Vault — glacial, shimmering, lonely-beautiful; the stillest, most tender place in the north, suspended and never quite resolving.

tracks.title: Pale Vault Frost Lumenary
tracks.where: Pale Vault Frost Lumenary · The Held Flame Inn · Glacier Cottage
tracks.mood: Snow-Hushed Town — a small warm song against the cold: people and lanterns indoors, melancholy and intimate, hope that is fragile.

tracks.title: Pale Vault Undercroft
tracks.where: Pale Vault Undercroft · The Hourfold
tracks.mood: Glasslight — the glacier as a lush luminous reverie: ringing suspended chords, bell entries blooming and dissolving into echo; vast, sacred, still.

tracks.title: Hushfrost Pass
tracks.where: Hushfrost Pass · Aurora Hollow
tracks.mood: Lamp in the Canyon — a lone lamp in a frozen canyon, the cold at your back: sparse and tender enough to keep walking, hope holding on.

tracks.title: The Old Light — The Lobby of Groaners
tracks.where: The Old Light — The Lobby of Groaners · The Old Light — The Late Laugh · The Old Light — Intermission · The Old Light — The Backwards Inn · Sunken Solarium
tracks.mood: Remembered Summer: stored daylight glowing up through the water - warm, nostalgic, everything in the past tense; the first real warmth since the south.

tracks.title: Solar Lumenary
tracks.where: Solar Lumenary
tracks.mood: Drowned Halls: the same sun-garden with the water winning - cooler, lonelier, a summer theme recoloured into its relative minor; bittersweet warmth spent knowing it fades.

tracks.title: The Old Light — The Gallery of Confident Facts
tracks.where: The Old Light — The Gallery of Confident Facts · The Unrisen Stair
tracks.mood: Sunsketch Bloom: the relit reading - daylight surging back into the drowned garden, the motif sung twice and the second time brighter; the score reaching toward dawn.

tracks.title: Sunvault Climb
tracks.where: Sunvault Climb · Sunfall
tracks.mood: Vines to the Sky: warm, ascending, hopeful - every phrase climbs like the terraces; the sunniest route in the West.

tracks.title: Helia Vault
tracks.where: Helia Vault
tracks.mood: First Light at the Top: Solar warmth meets the first true starlight - the climbing hook at its highest, doubled in bells, inside a sunlit reliquary of blooms and sun-mirrors.

tracks.title: Nightreach Observatory
tracks.where: Nightreach Observatory
tracks.mood: Under the Whole Sky: vast, lonely, wondrous - a single voice under every star, faint telescope clockwork, minor lifting toward major like hope dawning.

tracks.title: Lunar Lumenary
tracks.where: Lunar Lumenary · The Long Watch Inn · Watcher's Cottage
tracks.mood: The Haunted Lumenary: the loneliest room in Vesperholm - a minor lullaby that reaches up and never quite comes home, a clock running down; hope present but not yet earned.

tracks.title: Coldfog Marches
tracks.where: Coldfog Marches · Drownlight Beacon · Hollowfen Stillworks · Murkfall
tracks.mood: Snuffed — a drained marsh where the lanterns went out; a lone melody that keeps reaching for home and guttering before it gets there.

tracks.title: Penumbra Ring
tracks.where: Penumbra Ring · Starwell
tracks.mood: Wall of Ink: the last dark, crossed on starlight; a held breath, your heartbeat and one lonely lamp-note, hope leaking in at the edges.

tracks.title: Umbral Spire — Summit
tracks.where: Umbral Spire — Summit
tracks.mood: Crown of Null: the summit under the Keystar; grave, sorrowful grandeur and driving resolve, the hometown motif boomed in minor and promised its major.

tracks.title: Umbral Spire
tracks.where: Umbral Spire · Umbral Spire — Null-Works · Umbral Spire — High Gallery
tracks.mood: The Black Ascent: the climb through the dead Lumenary, null-lanterns leaking anti-light; relentless minor drive, all tension and no release.

tracks.title: Umbral Spire
tracks.where: Umbral Spire summit, the Keystar relight cutscene
tracks.mood: First True Dawn: the Keystar catches and the whole sky lights; the hometown motif stated whole in radiant major, triumphant with a tear in it.

tracks.title: Dawnstead
tracks.where: Dawnstead
tracks.mood: The lullaby in full — the hometown theme finally meeting the sun, radiant, confident and a little teary.

tracks.title: Dawn breaks
tracks.where: The ending cinematic (dawn breaks over Vesperholm)
tracks.mood: The long night ends: first light walking across every valley; the hometown lullaby finally meets the sun, radiant and tender.

tracks.title: Ending credits
tracks.where: The ending credits roll
tracks.mood: The Road Remembered: a warm medley walking back down the whole journey in memory, every road leading home to the hometown theme in daylight.

tracks.title: Battle — the last stand
tracks.where: The final battles: Warden Còr at the Umbral Spire summit, and Star-tender Fenn's post-game duel
tracks.mood: The last stand on the black mountain — grand, tragic and driving: a sorrowful antagonist who wants a gentle endless night, and the light that will not go out.

tracks.title: Battle — route trainers & Lampwardens
tracks.where: Trainer battles: every Lampwarden duel for a Gleam (Brisa, Reyl, Sable, Otho), the Beacon and route trainers, and Wren's first friendly bout
tracks.mood: The arena duel — proud, rousing and fair: a respected challenger in the lantern-light, the fight that earns a constellation.

tracks.title: Battle — the Three Hours
tracks.where: The Three Hours set-piece battles (Gloamber, Noctilune, Erstmorn — the legendary trio)
tracks.mood: Fighting a keeper of the sky's turning — awed, patient and vast, like a great clock: a jammed wheel rocking toward the next hour.

tracks.title: Battle — wild kin & trainers
tracks.where: Every wild kin battle (the default battle bed) and the attract-mode trailer duel
tracks.mood: The fight you hear a thousand times — urgent, catchy and winnable: a minor-key chase that bursts into a heroic major lift.

tracks.title: Battle — Vigilants & the Hollowing
tracks.where: The Hollowing's acolytes and Vigilants (incl. the summit guard), and the far-valley Lampwardens of the North and West (Mira Vael, Ysolde Frost, Lucan Pyre, Nessa Cole)
tracks.mood: The fight in the deepening dark — cold, uneasy and solemn: an enemy who believes in the gentle night, sorrow under the steel.

tracks.title: Battle — Wren, your rival
tracks.where: Rival battles with Wren (Pale Vault, Nightreach, and the post-game rematch)
tracks.mood: The rival who grew up beside you — cocky, quick, competitive and fond: a grin across the field, and the friendship under it.

tracks.title: Title screen
tracks.where: Title screen
tracks.mood: The calling card: a lone lantern-tune in the dark explodes into a heroic minor adventure anthem; the Long Dusk, and the journey rising against it.

tracks.title: The cold open
tracks.where: The cold-open cinematic (the Long Dusk falls; a star winks out)
tracks.mood: The Long Dusk falling: hushed foreboding under a sky losing its lanterns, a fragile hopeful phrase that reaches up and is never answered.

tracks.title: A Gleam relit
tracks.where: Every Gleam payoff — the moment a constellation relights and the town begins to celebrate (and the dawn)
tracks.mood: Belonging, not a trophy: the motif heard in the long dusk's minor, then blooming into warm major as the sky answers.

tracks.title: A Gleam relit (fanfare)
tracks.where: The Gleam moment — a constellation relit (played as a sting by the cutscene's gleam op)
tracks.mood: A lantern lifted to the sky: a short triumphant fanfare that quotes the hometown motif and lands firmly home.

tracks.title: The Hours (sting)
tracks.where: The Three Hours' threshold — the moment an Hour is met, just before its set-piece battle
tracks.mood: A single great bell tolls the hour: deep, awed, with a long shimmering tail.
